Emit JSON schema of a command's arguments and flags

Machine-readable introspection for AI agents. Outputs the accepted positionals, flags, types, defaults, and constraints for a command.

Aliases: `d`

```sh
woco describe [command] [flags]
```

Read-only.

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | no | Command to describe (e.g. 'launch', 'features add') |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
